title: Level 2 Maths and English added to ARP
details: Adds Maths Level 2 directly below Practical in Assessment Readiness & Practice
Adds English Level 2 directly below Maths in Assessment Readiness & Practice
Includes a Level 2 Maths mock with non-calculator and calculator sections
Includes Level 2 English Reading, Writing and Speaking, Listening and Communicating practice
Answers and self-marked progress stay on the learner's device
summary: Evia v192 adds offline Functional Skills Level 2 Maths and English directly inside the Test/ARP area, below Practical.
